name: Indurium Ore
objectiveText: Progress I'd like to integrate indurium into different parts of our racers, but I need large amounts of raw indurium to create these parts. You can find indurium ore in the Uldaman excavation in the Badlands, across the sea in Khaz Modan. The gnomes are getting their own supply of it, so it's important we get our own to keep pace with them. Indurium Ore  ( 4 )

comments.body: Do this if you need to waste time and bag space. You get 6 silver - no rep, no experience, no reward, no item to click that will give you back the time you threw away going to The Not-So-Shimmering Flats.

Blue ? - Repeatable.... 

Think its just free money at this point for running ulda.  but the chain to get there gives a nice amount of XP and rep.

First you have to do these quests from this chain.

[url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=1106/martek-the-exiled]https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=1106/martek-the-exiled[/url]

then you can pick up this quest

You need to mine the ore from in Uldaman (there is definately some in the instance, possibly outside the instance as well - not sure), or buy them off someone who has some (possibly a miner in your group in Uldaman).
I still have the sample of indurium ore... :/

Upon completion of the 'News for Fizzle' quest (at lv 42), I went over to Pozzik and picked up 'Keeping Pace' (which is where you speak to Zamek, and he supplies a distraction for you to steal the gnomes' plans).
When you "steal" the plans, you're offered the quest 'Rizzle's Schematics' which has you bring back the Sample of Indurium Ore that appears in your pack, to Pozzik.
Pozzik then offers you a repeatable quest of retrieving 4 Indurium Ore found in Uldaman. This repeatable quest does not show up in your log.

For completing 'Keeping Pace', I was awarded 1650 exp pts and 50 reputation for Ratchet. For completing 'Rizzle's Schematics' I was awarded the same again.
Anyone know anything about this quest? Like who gives it?

When I handed Pozzik 4 x Indurium Ore, I got the quest completion as such:

Received 6 Silver
Indurium Ore <needs reward -- repeatable> completed.

No XP, no faction increase, nothing.

Did you guys get [url=/item=5866]Sample of Indurium Ore[/url] if so what is it for? I forget since it was such a long time ago.

i suppose its nice to have if you want to level mining and are going to the instance alot... im kind of disappointed by the level of work to get to it though
